'''Adam Peter Lanza''' (April 22, 1992 – December 14, 2012) was an American [[mass murderer]] who perpetrated the [[Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting]], one of the deadliest [[Mass shooting|mass shootings]] and mass murders in American history.<ref>{{Cite web |title=us-shooting-history-of-deadliest-massacres |url=https://news.sky.com/story/us-shooting-history-of-deadliest-massacres-10460699 |website=new.sky.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2012-12-14 |title=Connecticut school shooting is second worst in US history |url=http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/connecticut-school-shooting-second-worst-us-history-flna1C7615971 |access-date=2026-10-02 |website=NBC News |language=en}}</ref> On December 14, 2012, he fatally shot his mother, Nancy Lanza, at their home in [[Newtown, Connecticut]], before driving to Sandy Hook Elementary School, where he murdered 20 children aged six and seven, and six adult staff members. He then killed himself as law enforcement arrived at the school.

Lanza was born in [[Exeter, New Hampshire]], and grew up in Newtown, Connecticut, where he was raised primarily by his mother following his parents' divorce in 2008. From an early age, he was diagnosed with several neurodevelopmental conditions, including [[Asperger syndrome]], [[sensory processing disorder]], and [[obsessive–compulsive disorder]] (OCD). He was described by those who knew him as highly intelligent but profoundly withdrawn. He struggled throughout his childhood and adolescence with social interaction and emotional regulation, and hated to be touched.

As a teenager, Lanza became increasingly isolated and had no close friends throughout middle and high school. His anxiety led to him being placed on [[Homeschooling|homebound status]] in middle school, receiving instructions at home rather than attending classes. He recouped by high school and started attending classes again as well as socializing, applying for university and college classes for extra credit. He graduated high school early at 16. His mother declined treatments recommended by the [[Yale Child Study Center]], preferring to accommodate his preferences rather than forcing him to adapt to social environments and improving his mental health. By 2010, Lanza withdrew from almost all social contact, cut off all contact with his father and brother, and became a recluse in his mother's home, using trash bags to black out the windows in his bedroom. By 2012, he refused to leave his room and communicated with his mother only through email. He developed an intense preoccupation with mass violence, compiling extensive research on prior shootings and discussing the topic with others via online forums and websites.

Lanza had access to an arsenal of legally purchased firearms belonging to his mother, an avid gun enthusiast, which he would use to carry out the murders. Severe mental illness, social isolation, and access to weapons were all identified as contributing factors to the shooting by Connecticut state authorities and the Office of the Child Advocate. The Sandy Hook shooting led to renewed legislative efforts on gun control at both the state and federal level. Nancy Lanza's role in facilitating her son's access to firearms became a significant point of public and legal scrutiny.

== Early life and education ==
=== Elementary and middle school years ===
Adam Peter Lanza was born on April 22, 1992, in [[Exeter, New Hampshire]],<ref name="death-certificate">{{cite web |url=https://schoolshooters.info/sites/default/files/Lanza_death_certificate.pdf |title=Lanza death certificate |last=Holstead |first=Debbie Aurelia |date=2012 |publisher=State of Connecticut Department of Health |access-date=19 February 2026}}</ref> the second son of Peter and Nancy Lanza ({{Nee}} Champion).<ref name="footprints">{{Cite news |last=Halbfinger |first=David M. |date=2012-12-15 |title=A Gunman, Recalled as Intelligent and Shy, Who Left Few Footprints in Life |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2012/12/15/nyregion/adam-lanza-an-enigma-who-is-now-identified-as-a-mass-killer.html |access-date=2026-02-08 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331 |archive-date=December 16, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121216205908/http://www.nytimes.com//2012/12/15/nyregion/adam-lanza-an-enigma-who-is-now-identified-as-a-mass-killer.html |url-status=live}}</ref> Nancy experienced [[hypotension]] and [[hypoglycemia]] among other problems during the pregnancy, and gave birth to Adam via [[C-section]] due to decreased fetal movement.<ref name="langman-2024">{{cite web |url=https://schoolshooters.info/sites/default/files/bio-psycho-social-cultural_1.pdf |title=Bio-Psycho-Social-Cultural: Four Domains of Factors Contributing to School Shootings |last=Langman |first=Peter |date=July 6, 2025 |website=SchoolShooters.info |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260223135041/https://schoolshooters.info/sites/default/files/bio-psycho-social-cultural_1.pdf |archive-date=February 23, 2026 |url-status=live |access-date=May 10, 2026}}</ref> The Lanza family moved to [[Newtown, Connecticut]], after Peter started a new job at [[General Electric]] in 1998.<ref name="courant-med-recs"/><ref name=frustrating-wapo/><ref name="duluth-2013"/> Reports say that when he was younger, he learned to shoot through the Cub Scouts.<ref>{{cite web|title=Marvin LaFontaine: "Those Kids Were Everything" to Nancy Lanza| website=[[PBS]] |url=https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/frontline/article/marvin-lafontaine-those-kids-were-everything-to-nancy-lanza//?amp=1}}</ref> Lanza had a pet [[hamster]] named Skippy.<ref name="courant-spreadsheet"/>

Lanza attended Sandy Hook Elementary School for four and a half years.<ref name="AMWGO">{{cite news |last1=Stoller |first1=Gary |last2=Dorell |first2=Oren |date=December 19, 2012 |title=Classmate says Adam Lanza attended Sandy Hook school |url=https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/2012/12/18/adam-lanza-sandy-hook-student/1777525/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201112031129/https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/2012/12/18/adam-lanza-sandy-hook-student/1777525/ |archive-date=November 12, 2020 |access-date=February 20, 2026 |newspaper=[[USA Today]]}}</ref> Nancy's house was located five miles away from Sandy Hook Elementary School.<ref name="llanos-2012">{{cite web |last1=Llanos |first1=Miguel |title=Authorities ID gunman who killed 27 in elementary school massacre |url=http://usnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2012/12/14/15911025-authorities-id-gunman-who-killed-27-in-elementary-school-massacre?lite |website=NBC News |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121216022608/http://usnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2012/12/14/15911025-authorities-id-gunman-who-killed-27-in-elementary-school-massacre?lite |access-date=December 14, 2012 |archive-date=December 16, 2012 }}</ref><ref name="EveningSun"/> His father, Peter, described him as a "normal little weird kid" who enjoyed playing with [[Lego]]s and inventing board games.<ref name="The Reckoning"/> While teachers noted he was academically bright, he required an [[Individualized Education Program]] (IEP) for speech and social-emotional support from preschool onward.<ref name="courant-med-recs"/>{{rp|p=3}} Within the local region, Sandy Hook Elementary School had a reputation for being accommodating to special needs students in the late 1990s.<ref name="courant-med-recs"/>{{rp|p=2}}

Lanza's parents separated in 2002{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=25}} with Peter living in an apartment in downtown [[Stamford, Connecticut]] while Nancy remained in the family home.<ref name="leger-custody-2012"/>
When Adam was interviewed by a psychiatrist in 2006, he answered that his parents separated probably because they "irritated" each other just as they irritate him.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=25}}<ref name="courant-2018-docs"/><ref name="latimes-2018">{{Cite web |last1=Kovner |first1=Josh |last2=Altimari |first2=Dave |date=2018-12-09 |title=More than 1,000 pages of documents reveal Sandy Hook shooter Adam Lanza's dark descent |url=https://www.latimes.com/nation/la-na-adam-lanza-sandy-hook-20181209-story.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250827202419/https://www.latimes.com/nation/la-na-adam-lanza-sandy-hook-20181209-story.html |archive-date=August 27, 2025 |access-date=2026-02-08 |website=Los Angeles Times |language=en-US}}</ref>
Peter did not believe that his separation from Nancy negatively impacted their children.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=26}}
He spent as much time with his children after the separation as before it, since he worked full-time and only saw his children on weekends.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=26}}

Lanza attended Reed Intermediate School for sixth grade in 2003.<ref name="leger-alcindor">{{cite news |last1=Leger |first1=Donna Leinwand |last2=Alcindor |first2=Yamiche |date=December 16, 2012 |title=Adam Lanza: Withdrawn teen a mystery then and now |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2012/12/16/adam-lanza-remembered-as-withdrawn-teen/1773829/ |publisher=USA Today |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250818081540/https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2012/12/16/adam-lanza-remembered-as-withdrawn-teen/1773829/ |archive-date=August 18, 2025 |access-date=May 9, 2026}}</ref> Lanza started attending Newtown Middle School in 2004.<ref name="courant-med-recs">{{cite news |url=http://www.courant.com:80/hc-adam-lanzas-medical-records-reveal-growing-anxiety-20141121-story.html |title=Adam Lanza's Medical Records Reveal Growing Anxiety |first1=Alaine |last1=Griffin |first2=Josh |last2=Kovner |date=June 30, 2013 |access-date=September 22, 2018 |newspaper=[[The Hartford Courant]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180302081135/http://www.courant.com/hc-adam-lanzas-medical-records-reveal-growing-anxiety-20141121-story.html |archive-date=March 2, 2018 |url-status=live}}</ref> The transition to middle school—where he had to change classrooms and navigate noisy hallways—was physically and emotionally overwhelming for him. His mother reported that he experienced intense anxiety during this period.<ref name="courant-med-recs"/> She told friends that her son started getting upset in middle school because of frequent classroom changes during the day. The movement and noise were too stimulating and made him anxious. At one point, his anxiety was so intense that she took him to the emergency room at [[Danbury Hospital]].<ref name="courant-med-recs"/>

In 2006, Lanza's mother noted some abnormal changes about her son's behavior around the seventh grade. He discontinued playing the saxophone, dropped out of a school band that he was previously in, and withdrew from playing soccer or baseball which he said he did not enjoy.<ref>{{cite web|title=Newtown| website=[[PBS]] |url=https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/frontline/article/marvin-lafontaine-those-kids-were-everything-to-nancy-lanza//?amp=1}}</ref> Because of the smaller class sizes, his mother moved him to a parochial school, [[St. Rose of Lima Church (Newtown, Connecticut)|St. Rose of Lima]], in April 2005.<ref name=frustrating-wapo>{{Cite news |last1=Fisher |first1=Marc |last2=O'Harrow |first2=Robert |last3=Finn |first3=Peter |date=December 22, 2012 |title=A frustrating search for motive in Newtown shootings |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/a-frustrating-search-for-motive-in-the-madness/2012/12/22/1cbe1cbc-4956-11e2-820e-17eefac2f939_story.html |access-date=August 12, 2022 |newspaper=Washington Post |archive-date=September 24, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220924070450/https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/a-frustrating-search-for-motive-in-the-madness/2012/12/22/1cbe1cbc-4956-11e2-820e-17eefac2f939_story.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="courant-med-recs"/> Lanza attended St. Rose of Lima for only eight weeks and left in June 2005.<ref name="courant-med-recs"/> By eighth grade, his anxiety was so severe that he was placed on homebound status, receiving instruction at home rather than in a classroom.

At age 10, Lanza co-authored the ''Big Book of Granny'', which contained graphic descriptions of violence against children,<ref name="south-bend"/> indicating a very early preoccupation that went largely unaddressed.<ref name="salam-2017"/>
In the seventh grade, Lanza wrote a 10-page essay titled "Battles, Destruction and War" that caused a teacher to believe he was consumed by "feelings of rage, hate and (at least unconscious) murderous impulses".<ref name="katersky-2014"/>
The writing was described by the educator as so graphic and violent that it could not be shared with the rest of the class.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Press |first=Associated |date=2013-12-30 |title=Documents highlight heroics, horror in Newtown |url=https://www.deseret.com/2013/12/30/20460492/documents-highlight-heroics-horror-in-newtown/ |access-date=2026-02-09 |website=Deseret News |language=en |archive-date=March 16, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250316103147/https://www.deseret.com/2013/12/30/20460492/documents-highlight-heroics-horror-in-newtown/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="south-bend"/> The teacher then asked Lanza to write something else to share with the class.<ref name="south-bend"/> Lanza later wrote and presented a poem to a public audience which was so lovely that it made his father cry.<ref name="south-bend"/>

=== High school and university years ===
Lanza attended [[Newtown High School (Connecticut)|Newtown High School]], where he was active in a technology club, for which he once hosted a [[LAN party]] at his house where he played games with other students in the club.<ref name="frustrating-wapo2" /><ref name="The Reckoning2">{{cite magazine |last=Solomon |first=Andrew |date=March 17, 2014 |title=The Reckoning |url=http://www.newyorker.com/magazine/2014/03/17/the-reckoning |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170822134307/http://www.newyorker.com/magazine/2014/03/17/the-reckoning |archive-date=August 22, 2017 |access-date=August 22, 2017 |magazine=[[The New Yorker]]}}</ref> but remained socially isolated. Students and teachers who knew him in high school described Lanza as "intelligent but nervous and fidgety". He avoided attracting attention and was uncomfortable socializing. He was not known to have had any close friends in school.<ref name="footprints" /> The intense anxiety Lanza experienced at the time suggests his autism might have been exacerbated by the hormonal shifts of adolescence.<ref name="The Reckoning">{{cite magazine |first=Andrew |last=Solomon |url=http://www.newyorker.com/magazine/2014/03/17/the-reckoning |title=The Reckoning |magazine=[[The New Yorker]] |issn=0028-792X |date=March 17, 2014 |access-date=August 22, 2017 |archive-date=August 22, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170822134307/http://www.newyorker.com/magazine/2014/03/17/the-reckoning |url-status=live}}</ref> Lanza was named to the [[Honors Student|honor roll]] a few times,<ref name="NPRYost12-15-12">{{cite news|last1=Yost |first1=Pete |last2=Keyser |first2=Jason |title=Correction: Conn school shooting-suspect story |agency=Associated Press |work=NPR |url=https://www.npr.org/templates/story/story.php?storyId=167291334 |date=December 15, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121215102959/http://www.npr.org/templates/story/story.php?storyId=167291334 |archive-date=December 15, 2012}}</ref><ref name="newstimes-2007">{{Cite news |url=http://www.newstimes.com/news/article/Newtown-High-School-honor-roll-54220.php |title=Newtown High School honor roll |work=The News-Times |date=May 5, 2007 |access-date=October 24, 2017 |archive-date=October 25, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171025074723/http://www.newstimes.com/news/article/Newtown-High-School-honor-roll-54220.php |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="leger-alcindor" /> but there are no photos of him inside the high school [[yearbook]]s.<ref name="leger-alcindor" />

At age 16, while still a high school student, Lanza enrolled in classes at [[Western Connecticut State University]] and [[Norwalk Community College]] in 2008 and 2009, respectively, for extra credit for high school. At Western Connecticut, two classmates described him as nice, quiet (which was believed to be because of how much younger he was compared to everybody else) who would smile sometimes, participate upon being called on by the teacher, and who they would said hi to from time to time. He was once invited to a bar by two classmates but he declined stating that he was only 17.<ref name="huffingtonpost">{{cite news |url=http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2012/12/17/adam-lanza-college-courses_n_2315431.html |title=Adam Lanza Took Western Connecticut State University Courses When He Was 16 |work=Huffington Post |date=December 17, 2012 |access-date=December 19, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121219151033/http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2012/12/17/adam-lanza-college-courses_n_2315431.html |archive-date=December 19, 2012}}</ref> He maintained a 3.26 [[Grading in education|GPA]] on his college transcript,<ref name="huffingtonpost" /><ref name="leger-alcindor" /><ref name="goldstein-2013" /> and a 3.89 GPA on his high school transcript.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=68}} He earned an A in [[Visual Basic (.NET)|Visual Basic]] [[computer programming]], an A− in website production, an A− in [[History of the United States|American history]] since 1877, a B in [[macroeconomics]], and a C in Introduction to Ethical Theory, his lowest passing grade. However, he dropped out of several classes in these years which were Data Modelling, introductory German, which he reported to an aforementioned classmate that he had received a D in an exam before dropping out, computer science, and Database (DB) design.<ref name="huffingtonpost" />{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=74}}<ref name="duluth-2013" /> His mother eventually withdrew him from high school to finish his credits early through a mix of tutoring and independent study.<ref name="BBC-2012">{{Cite news |date=2012-12-15 |title=Adam Lanza: Profile of suspected Newtown gunman |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-20738732 |access-date=2026-02-08 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB |archive-date=February 7, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250207163751/https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-20738732 |url-status=live }}</ref> He earned his high school diploma from Newtown High School at age 16 through a combination of tutoring, independent learning and college classes.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Dixon |first=Ken |title=Report: 'Missed opportunities' to stop Sandy Hook killer |url=https://www.ctpost.com/local/article/Report-Missed-opportunities-to-stop-Sandy-Hook-5909052.php |access-date=May 23, 2024 |work=[[Connecticut Post]] |language=en |archive-date=May 23, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240523055822/https://www.ctpost.com/local/article/Report-Missed-opportunities-to-stop-Sandy-Hook-5909052.php |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="FRONTLINE" /> The Office of the Child Advocate later concluded that his schools often focused on managing his symptoms rather than addressing the underlying social-emotional deficits.

For a while, Lanza worked as an independent contractor at a computer repair shop until it went out of business, as indicated in a written letter from his employer in March 2009.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=69}}<ref name="duluth-2013" /><ref name="pearce-2013" />
Lanza's employer described him as "cordial, professional" and having "expert attributes".{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=69}}<ref name=":1" /><ref name="langman-2015" />
Lanza had some interest in enlisting in the military when he was 18, but he never did.<ref name="frustrating-wapo" /><ref name="The Reckoning" /><ref name="langman-2024" />
Lanza got his driver's license in 2010.<ref name="frustrating-wapo" /><ref name=":1" />

Lanza's parents divorced in September 2009 after Nancy filed for divorce in November 2008, citing "[[Irreconcilable differences|the marriage has broken down irretrievably]]".<ref name="martinez-2012">{{Cite web |last1=Martinez |first1=Michael |last2=Ariosto |first2=David |date=2012-12-15 |title=Adam Lanza's family: Mom liked parlor games, guns; dad, a tax exec, remarried |url=https://www.cnn.com/2012/12/15/us/connecticut-lanza-family-profile |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250719084541/https://www.cnn.com/2012/12/15/us/connecticut-lanza-family-profile/ |archive-date=July 19, 2025 |access-date=2026-02-08 |website=CNN |language=en}}</ref>
Observers and court documents described the split as relatively amicable, with no public disputes over property or parenting.<ref name="seville-2012">{{cite web |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/news/investigations/new-details-emerge-private-lives-school-gunman-adam-lanza-his-flna1C7653717 |title=New details emerge on private lives of school gunman Adam Lanza and his mother |last1=Seville |first1=Lisa Riordan |last2=Isikoff |first2=Michael |date=December 17, 2012 |website=NBC News |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260324105135/https://www.nbcnews.com/news/investigations/new-details-emerge-private-lives-school-gunman-adam-lanza-his-flna1C7653717 |archive-date=March 24, 2026 |url-status=live |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="martinez-2012"/>
Peter agreed to a substantial alimony arrangement that provided Nancy with nearly $290,000 annually by 2012.<ref name="leger-custody-2012"/>
He also committed to paying for both sons' college and graduate educations.<ref name="leger-custody-2012"/>
They shared joint legal custody of Adam, who was 17 at the time of the finalization, though he lived primarily with Nancy.<ref name="leger-custody-2012">{{Cite web |last=Leger |first=Donna Leinwand |title=Wife got custody of son who became mass killer |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2012/12/17/lanza-sandy-hook-massacre-divorce/1776073/ |access-date=2026-02-08 |website=USA TODAY |language=en-US |archive-date=November 16, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251116133002/https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2012/12/17/lanza-sandy-hook-massacre-divorce/1776073/ |url-status=live}}</ref>
The agreement gave Nancy the final decision-making power if they could not agree on issues regarding Lanza, as she always had.<ref name="leger-custody-2012"/>

=== Relationships with his mother and others ===
Nancy became a housewife mother shortly after Adam was born.
He had access to the guns used in the shooting through his mother, who was described as a "gun enthusiast who owned at least a dozen firearms".<ref name="cbsarsenal12-16-12">{{cite news |title=Friends: Newtown gunman's mother home-schooled son, kept arsenal of guns |url=http://newyork.cbslocal.com/2012/12/16/friends-newtown-gunmans-mother-home-schooled-son-kept-arsenal-of-guns/ |work=CBS News |date=December 16, 2012 |access-date=December 17, 2012 |archive-date=December 19, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121219044839/http://newyork.cbslocal.com/2012/12/16/friends-newtown-gunmans-mother-home-schooled-son-kept-arsenal-of-guns/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="NYBankoff">{{cite news |last=Bankoff |first=Caroline |title=Newtown Shooter Adam Lanza's Mother Was an Avid Gun Collector |work=New York |date=December 2012 |url=http://nymag.com/daily/intelligencer/2012/12/adam-lanzas-mother-was-an-avid-gun-collector.html |access-date=December 16, 2012 |archive-date=December 16, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121216200413/http://nymag.com/daily/intelligencer/2012/12/adam-lanzas-mother-was-an-avid-gun-collector.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Investigators look for insight into Newtown gunman's mind">{{cite news |title=Investigators look for insight into Newtown gunman's mind |url=http://boston.cbslocal.com/2012/12/14/newtown-school-shooting-who-is-adam-lanza/ |work=CBS News |agency=Associated Press |date=December 14, 2012 |access-date=December 16, 2012 |archive-date=December 19, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121219133749/http://boston.cbslocal.com/2012/12/14/newtown-school-shooting-who-is-adam-lanza/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Survivalists">{{cite news |url=https://news.yahoo.com/blogs/lookout/survivalists-worry-preppers-scapegoated-newtown-shooting-213541985.html |work=Yahoo! News |title=Survivalists worry 'preppers' will be scapegoated for Newtown shooting |last=Goodwin |first=Liz |date=December 19, 2012 |access-date=December 19, 2012 |archive-date=January 17, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130117052620/http://news.yahoo.com/blogs/lookout/survivalists-worry-preppers-scapegoated-newtown-shooting-213541985.html |url-status=live}}</ref>
She often took her two sons to a local shooting range, where they learned to shoot.<ref name="Connecticut school shooting: Troubled life of Adam Lanza, a fiercely intelligent killer">{{cite news |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/northamerica/usa/9747682/Connecticut-school-shooting-troubled-life-of-Adam-Lanza-a-fiercely-intelligent-killer.html |title=Connecticut school shooting: Troubled life of Adam Lanza, a fiercely intelligent killer |newspaper=The Daily Telegraph |location=London |first1=Harriet |last1=Alexander |first2=David |last2=Barrett |first3=Laura |last3=Donnelly |first4=Jon |last4=Swaine |date=December 15, 2012 |access-date=April 5, 2018 |archive-date=April 18, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180418164407/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/northamerica/usa/9747682/Connecticut-school-shooting-troubled-life-of-Adam-Lanza-a-fiercely-intelligent-killer.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="nydailynews2">{{cite news |url=http://www.nydailynews.com/news/national/conn-gunman-learned-shoot-mom-article-1.1220893 |title=Newtown, Conn. shooting: Sandy Hook elementary school gunman Adam Lanza learned to shoot from his gun-collecting mom |first1=Matthew |last1=Lysiak |first2=Dennis |last2=Slattery |first3=Corky |last3=Siemaszko |work=Daily News |location=New York |access-date=December 15, 2012 |date=December 15, 2012 |archive-date=December 15, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121215184629/http://www.nydailynews.com/news/national/conn-gunman-learned-shoot-mom-article-1.1220893 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=frustrating-wapo/> Lanza's father, Peter, has said that he does not believe Nancy feared Adam. She did not confide any fear of him to her sister or to her best friend, slept with her bedroom door unlocked, and kept guns in the house.<ref name="The Reckoning" /> Adam struggled with showing basic emotions and would be coached by his mother when he was young. Adam was involved in a school play during his childhood, his mother had written to a friend "Adam has taken it very seriously, even practicing facial expressions in the mirror!"<ref name="The Reckoning" /> The state's attorney report on the shooting states that when Nancy asked Adam whether he would feel sad if anything happened to her, he replied "No."<ref>{{cite magazine |last1=Park |first1=Alice |title=Don't Blame Adam Lanza's Violence on Asperger's |url=https://time.com/19957/adam-lanzas-violence-wasnt-typical-of-aspergers/ |magazine=Time |date=March 11, 2014 |access-date=January 11, 2024 |archive-date=March 11, 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140311235314/http://time.com/19957/adam-lanzas-violence-wasnt-typical-of-aspergers/ |url-status=live }}</ref> After her divorce, Nancy would take vacations to leave Adam alone in the house for days at a time, hoping that it would make Adam become more independent.<ref name="duluth-2013" /><ref name="pearce-2013">{{cite news |last=Pearce |first=Matt |date=February 20, 2013 |title=Adam and Nancy Lanza: An investigation into their family life |url=https://www.latimes.com/nation/la-xpm-2013-feb-20-la-na-nn-lanza-courant-investigation-20130220-story.html |work=Los Angeles Times |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250822124130/https://www.latimes.com/nation/la-xpm-2013-feb-20-la-na-nn-lanza-courant-investigation-20130220-story.html |archive-date=August 22, 2025 |access-date=May 10, 2026}}</ref>
She went to fine restaurants, slept in hotels, was in [[Boston]] on a regular basis, and occasionally flew to England, New Orleans, and San Francisco.<ref name="duluth-2013" /><ref name="pearce-2013" />
Before each trip, she left prepared meals in the refrigerator for Adam to eat.<ref name="duluth-2013" /> In 2010, Lanza became a complete recluse.<ref name=":1" />
He lived in his mother's home, where he used black trash bags to black out the windows of his bedroom.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bonvillian |first=Crystal |date=2018-12-10 |title='Nothing but scorn for humanity': Documents show dark decline of Sandy Hook shooter Adam Lanza |url=https://www.wsoctv.com/news/trending-now/nothing-but-scorn-for-humanity-newly-released-writings-show-evolution-of-sandy-hook-shooter/886821949/ |access-date=2026-02-08 |website=WSOC TV |language=en |archive-date=January 22, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220122211438/https://www.wsoctv.com/news/trending-now/nothing-but-scorn-for-humanity-newly-released-writings-show-evolution-of-sandy-hook-shooter/886821949/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
He communicated with his mother, Nancy, almost exclusively via email, despite living together.
In the final months, he often refused to leave his room or engage with her at all.

He abruptly cut off all contact with his father, Peter, in 2010 and was estranged from his older brother, Ryan.<ref name="duluth-2013">{{Cite web |date=2013-02-19 |title=Raising Adam Lanza: Devoted mother was his first victim |url=https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/news/raising-adam-lanza-devoted-mother-was-his-first-victim |access-date=2026-02-08 |website=Duluth News Tribune |language=en |archive-date=June 4, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240604193024/https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/news/raising-adam-lanza-devoted-mother-was-his-first-victim |url-status=live}}</ref>
The [[no contact]] with his father may have been due to heated disagreement over whether Lanza could handle a full load of courses at Norwalk Community College.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=97}}<ref name="The Reckoning" />{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=74}} 
Lanza never had an [[intimate relationship]] with anyone, nor did he ever voluntarily hug anyone.<ref name="langman-2024" />
Lanza believed that if he ever had children, he would be a "phenomenal father", since he would raise them to be [[Freethought|freethinkers]] and respect their independence.<ref name="courant-2018-docs" /><ref name="nypost-2018" /><ref name="latimes-2018" />

== Mental health issues ==
Lanza exhibited developmental challenges before the age of three.
Early evaluations found "significant delay in social-personal development" and difficulty in being understood by others.<ref name="Newsweek-report-lanza's-life">{{Cite news |date=2014-11-25 |title=Report Details Adam Lanza's Life Before Sandy Hook Shootings - Newsweek |url=https://www.newsweek.com/report-details-adam-lanzas-life-sandy-hook-shootings-286867 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250723133450/https://www.newsweek.com/report-details-adam-lanzas-life-sandy-hook-shootings-286867 |archive-date=July 23, 2025 |access-date=2026-02-08 |work=Newsweek |language=en |url-status=live}}</ref>
By preschool, he was diagnosed with [[sensory processing disorder]], which made typical sights, sounds, and touch physically overwhelming for him.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Slideshow: Adam Lanza's Path to the Sandy Hook Tragedy |url=https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/frontline/article/slideshow-adam-lanzas-path-to-the-sandy-hook-tragedy/ |access-date=2026-02-08 |website=FRONTLINE {{!}} PBS {{!}} Official Site {{!}} Documentary Series |language=en}}</ref>
Sensory-processing disorder does not have official status in the medical community as a formal diagnosis, but is a common characteristic of autism.<ref name="spd">{{cite news |title=Newtown Shooter Lanza Had Sensory Processing Disorder |url=http://abpcnews.go.com/Health/newtown-shooter-adam-lanza-sensory-processing-disorder-controversial/story?id=18532645 |url-status=dead |work=ABC News |access-date=February 20, 2013}}</ref>
Lanza was seen by the New Hampshire Birth to Three intervention program and referred to special education preschool services.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=7}}

Lanza had communication difficulties, socialization delays, and repetitive behaviors.
Lanza did not speak until he was three years old.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Good |first=Dan |date=March 10, 2014 |title=Sandy Hook Gunman's Father Wishes Son Was Never Born |url=https://abcnews.com/US/sandy-hook-gunmans-father-wishes-son-born/story?id=22843084 |access-date=February 20, 2026 |website=ABC News |language=en-US}}</ref>
He frequently washed his hands and changed his socks 20 times a day, to the point where his mother did three loads of laundry a day.<ref name="gtdsT">{{cite web |url=http://www.politico.com/story/2013/12/newtown-shooting-police-file-101561.html |title=Police release documents on Newtown massacre |work=Politico |date=December 27, 2013 |access-date=January 14, 2014 |archive-date=December 31, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131231204759/http://www.politico.com/story/2013/12/newtown-shooting-police-file-101561.html |url-status=live}}</ref>
He also sometimes went through a box of tissues in a day because he could not touch a doorknob with his bare hand.<ref name="uwZOF">{{cite web|url=http://www.newsday.com/news/nation/adam-lanza-newtown-school-shooter-remains-enigma-despite-files-1.6684722|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131229114153/http://www.newsday.com/news/nation/adam-lanza-newtown-school-shooter-remains-enigma-despite-files-1.6684722|archive-date=December 29, 2013 |title=Adam Lanza, Newtown school shooter, remains enigma despite files |work=[[Newsday]] |access-date=December 29, 2013}}</ref>

When he was 13, Lanza was diagnosed with [[Asperger's syndrome]] by psychiatrist Paul Fox.<ref name="The Reckoning" />
Lanza exhibited extreme shyness and social awkwardness.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Salerian |first=Alen J. |date=2016 |title=Human Errors May Explain Prejudice of Mass Media against People with Autism |url=https://www.ceeol.com/search/article-detail?id=1297613 |journal=Journal of Psychology & Clinical Psychiatry |language=English |volume=5 |issue=4 |pages=1–5 |doi=10.15406/jpcpy.2016.05.00292 |issn=2373-6445}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite book |last=Farrell |first=Kirby |date=2016 |editor-last=Ataria |editor-first=Yochai |chapter=Killing the Killer: Rampage and Gun Rights as a Syndrome |editor2-last=Gurevitz |editor2-first=David |editor3-last=Pedaya |editor3-first=Haviva |editor4-last=Neria |editor4-first=Yuval |title=Interdisciplinary Handbook of Trauma and Culture |chapter-url=https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-319-29404-9_22 |language=en |publisher=Springer International Publishing |pages=353–363 |doi=10.1007/978-3-319-29404-9_22 |isbn=978-3-319-29404-9 |access-date=2026-02-09|chapter-url-access=subscription }}</ref>
His anxiety affected his ability to attend school and in 8th grade he was placed on "homebound" status, which is reserved for children who are too disabled, even with supports and accommodations, to attend school.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=8}}
When he was 14, his parents took him to [[Yale University]]'s [[Yale Child Study Center|Child Study Center]], where he was diagnosed with [[obsessive–compulsive disorder]] (OCD), [[Depression (mood)|depression]] and [[anxiety]].
<!-- Van Allen believes that Lanza's autism spectrum disorder contributed to his rejection of culture.<ref name="van-allen-2024"/>{{rp|pp=8-9}} -->

Lanza received treatment from Robert King, who advised implementing comprehensive support, and Kathleen Koenig, a colleague at the Yale Child Study Center, prescribed [[citalopram]], an [[antidepressant]]. Lanza took the medication for three days. His mother Nancy reported: "On the third morning he complained of dizziness. By that afternoon he was disoriented, his speech was disjointed, he couldn't even figure out how to open his cereal box. He was sweating profusely ... it was actually dripping off his hands. He said he couldn't think ... He was practically vegetative."<ref name="The Reckoning" /> He never took the medication again.<ref name="yale">{{cite news|title=Sandy Hook shooter treated at Yale|url=http://yaledailynews.com/blog/2014/01/22/sand-hook-shooter-treated-at-yale/|access-date=June 23, 2014|work=Yale Daily News|date=January 22, 2014|archive-date=July 3, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140703193410/http://yaledailynews.com/blog/2014/01/22/sand-hook-shooter-treated-at-yale/|url-status=live}}</ref> A report from the Office of the Child Advocate found that "Yale's recommendations for extensive special education supports, ongoing expert consultation, and rigorous therapeutic supports embedded into (Lanza's) daily life went largely unheeded."{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=7}}

Lanza appears to have had no contact with mental health providers after 2006. The report from the Office of the Child Advocate stated: "In the course of Lanza's entire life, minimal mental health evaluation and treatment (in relation to his apparent need) was obtained. Of the couple of providers that saw him, only one—the [[Yale Child Study Center]]—seemed to appreciate the gravity of (his) presentation, his need for extensive mental health and special education supports, and the critical need for medication to ease his obsessive–compulsive symptoms."{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=8}} Lanza received no psychiatric treatment or medication after 2008, despite being impaired by anxiety and obsessive–compulsive disorder (OCD).<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Kass |first=Jamie |date=2014-10-01 |title=Gun violence and mental illness |url=https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lanpsy/article/PIIS2215-0366(14)70382-7/abstract |journal=The Lancet Psychiatry |language=English |volume=1 |issue=5 |pages=335–336 |doi=10.1016/S2215-0366(14)70382-7 |pmid=26360993 |issn=2215-0366|url-access=subscription }}</ref> On a college admissions questionnaire, Lanza answered that he had no "documented disabling condition" and he declined to identify his gender.<ref name="goldstein-2013">{{cite news |last=Goldstein |first=Sasha |date=April 2, 2013 |title= Adam Lanza college records: Newtown shooter's bizarre questionnaire answers, good grades and creepy ID photo paint shocking portrait |url=https://www.nydailynews.com/2013/04/02/adam-lanza-college-records-newtown-shooters-bizarre-questionnaire-answers-good-grades-and-creepy-id-photo-paint-shocking-portrait/ |work=New York Daily News |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250819084616/https://www.nydailynews.com/2013/04/02/adam-lanza-college-records-newtown-shooters-bizarre-questionnaire-answers-good-grades-and-creepy-id-photo-paint-shocking-portrait/ |archive-date=August 19, 2025 |access-date=May 9, 2026}}</ref><ref name="langman-2024"/>

In interviews conducted in 2013, Peter Lanza speculated that his son's Asperger syndrome might have masked an undiagnosed condition such as schizophrenia. He said that the Asperger diagnosis may have led the family to interpret Adam's increasingly unusual behavior and isolation as expected features of the syndrome rather than something else was wrong.<ref name="The Reckoning" /><ref name="FRONTLINE">{{cite news|title=Raising Adam Lanza|url=http://video.pbs.org/video/2336615746/|access-date=December 11, 2013|work=Frontline|publisher=PBS|date=February 19, 2013|archive-date=December 16, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131216055019/http://video.pbs.org/video/2336615746/|url-status=live}}</ref> Peter F. Langman has also suggested that Lanza may have had undiagnosed schizophrenia, as he experienced a seemingly psychotic episode in 2010.<ref name="langman-2024"/> Lanza also showed symptoms consistent with schizophrenia, including [[blunted affect]], [[alogia]], [[anhedonia]], sensory sensitivities, and decreased [[nociception]].<ref name="langman-2024"/><ref name="BBC-2012"/> Because of concerns that published accounts of Lanza's autism could result in a backlash against others with the condition, [[Autism rights movement|autism advocates]] campaigned to clarify that autism is a [[Neurodevelopmental disorder|brain-related developmental]] disorder rather than a [[mental illness]].<ref name="Autism backlash">{{cite magazine|url=http://www.cnn.com/2012/12/19/health/shooting-autism/index.html|magazine=Time|title=Troubling legacy of Sandy Hook may be backlash against kids with autism|last=Rochman|first=Bonnie|date=December 19, 2012|access-date=December 20, 2012|archive-date=December 20, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121220150640/http://www.cnn.com/2012/12/19/health/shooting-autism/index.html|url-status=live}}</ref> Those advocates argued that the aggression displayed by Lanza in the shooting is not typically observed in the autistic population<ref name="Afraid of Autism">{{cite web|url=http://www.slate.com/articles/health_and_science/medical_examiner/2012/12/adam_lanza_asperger_s_can_autism_explain_the_sandy_hook_tragedy.html|work=[[Slate (magazine)|Slate]]|title=Don't Be Afraid of People With Autism: They are not cold-blooded killers|last=Lutz|first=Amy S.F.|date=December 17, 2012|access-date=December 20, 2012|archive-date=December 21, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121221004440/http://www.slate.com/articles/health_and_science/medical_examiner/2012/12/adam_lanza_asperger_s_can_autism_explain_the_sandy_hook_tragedy.html|url-status=live}}</ref> and none of the psychiatrists he consulted identified concerning indications of violence in his demeanor.<ref name="The Reckoning" />

At the time of his death, Lanza "was [[anorexia nervosa|anorexic]] (he was six feet tall (183 cm) and weighed 112 pounds (51 kg)), to the point of malnutrition and resultant brain damage."{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=102}}
Medical experts believe this severe malnutrition caused [[cognitive impairment]] and [[Brain injury|brain damage]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Cowan |first=Alison Leigh |date=2014-11-21 |title=Adam Lanza's Mental Problems 'Completely Untreated' Before Newtown Shootings, Report Says |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2014/11/22/nyregion/before-newtown-shootings-adam-lanzas-mental-problems-completely-untreated-report-says.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260118145401/https://www.nytimes.com/2014/11/22/nyregion/before-newtown-shootings-adam-lanzas-mental-problems-completely-untreated-report-says.html |archive-date=January 18, 2026 |access-date=2026-02-08 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last1=Rahman |first1=Tahir |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=4skZEQAAQBAJ&dq=%22adam+lanza%22+motive&pg=PA63 |title=Extreme Overvalued Beliefs: Clinical and Forensic Psychiatric Dimensions |last2=Abugel |first2=Jeffrey |date=2024 |publisher=Oxford University Press |isbn=978-0-19-761255-2 |language=en}}</ref> In November 2014, a report from the Office of the Child Advocate in Connecticut stated that "Anorexia may lead to cognitive impairment, and the combination of anorexia with an autism spectrum disorder and OCD likely heightened Lanza's risk of suicide."{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=102}} According to medical records, Lanza was [[vegan]] since he was 13 years old and disdained the [[mouthfeel]] of some foods.<ref name="courant-med-recs"/>

== Later life ==
=== Interest in pedophilia ===
At some point, Lanza wrote a 34-page [[college application]] essay on his computer where he argued that consensual [[pedophilia]] is not abhorrent, nor should it be illegal.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=101}}<ref name="langman-2015"/> The essay argued that modern attitudes towards pedophilia are arbitrarily constructed and children can consent to sexual activity with adults.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=101}} State investigators described the computer file as "advocating pedophiles' rights and the liberation of children".<ref name=":6">{{Cite web |date=2017-10-25 |title=FBI: Evidence shows Newtown shooter had sex interest in kids |url=https://6abc.com/post/fbi-evidence-shows-newtown-shooter-had-sex-interest-in-kids/2565096/ |access-date=2026-02-08 |website=6abc Philadelphia |language=en |archive-date=October 14, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251014104734/https://6abc.com/post/fbi-evidence-shows-newtown-shooter-had-sex-interest-in-kids/2565096/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="ConnecticutPost"/><ref name="langman-2015">{{cite journal |last1=Langman |first1=Peter |author-link=Peter F. Langman |date=July 7, 2025 |orig-year=2015 |title=The Enigma of Adam Lanza's Mind and Motivations for Murder |url=https://schoolshooters.info/sites/default/files/lanza_enigma_mind_motivations_2.pdf |journal=Journal of Campus Behavioral Intervention |volume=1 |issue=11 |publisher=National Behavioral Intervention Team Association |pages=1–16 |doi=10.64247/260307 |doi-broken-date=May 19, 2026 |access-date=April 2, 2026}}</ref> The essay had an obsessive, academic tone.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=101}}

According to [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] (FBI) documents, Lanza also wrote an outline for a screenplay titled ''Lovebound'' which describes a relationship between a 30-year-old man and a 10-year-old boy and views that child-adult relationships could be beneficial.<ref name="langman-2015"/><ref name="ConnecticutPost">{{cite news |last=Perrefort |first=Dirk |date=January 19, 2014 |title=Computer evidence shows Lanza's interest in pedophilia |url=http://www.ctpost.com/local/article/Computer-evidence-shows-Lanza-s-interest-in-5156605.php#photo-5651099 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171106210812/http://www.ctpost.com/local/article/Computer-evidence-shows-Lanza-s-interest-in-5156605.php#photo-5651099 |archive-date=November 6, 2017 |access-date=November 19, 2017 |work=[[Connecticut Post]]}}</ref><ref name=":6"/> On an online forum, Lanza wrote that he did not believe there should be an age of consent.<ref name="langman-2015"/><ref name="beast-online-life"/>

The Sandy Hook Advisory Commission concluded in 2014 that there was not enough information to determine whether Lanza was a victim of a pedophile.<ref name="ConnecticutPost"/>
In 2016, Lanza's ex-psychiatrist, Paul Fox, was arrested and charged with sexual assault on a former patient.<ref name="NYDN-fox-arrest">{{cite web |url=https://www.nydailynews.com/2016/04/22/ex-psychiatrist-to-sandy-hook-shooter-adam-lanza-charged-with-sexual-assault-of-former-patient/ |title=Ex-psychiatrist to Sandy Hook shooter Adam Lanza charged with sexual assault of former patient |last=Schapiro |first=Rich |date=April 22, 2016 |website=New York Daily News |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250404031348/https://www.nydailynews.com/2016/04/22/ex-psychiatrist-to-sandy-hook-shooter-adam-lanza-charged-with-sexual-assault-of-former-patient/ |archive-date=April 4, 2025 |url-status=live |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="courant-fox-arrest">{{cite web |url=https://www.courant.com/2016/04/22/psychiatrist-who-treated-adam-lanza-charged-with-sexually-assaulting-patient/ |title=Psychiatrist Who Treated Adam Lanza Charged With Sexually Assaulting Patient |last=Courant |first=Hartford |date=April 22, 2016 |website=Hartford Courant |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251114234616/https://www.courant.com/2016/04/22/psychiatrist-who-treated-adam-lanza-charged-with-sexually-assaulting-patient/ |archive-date=November 14, 2025 |url-status=live |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>
In a document that was later released to the public in 2018,<ref name="2018-court-order">{{cite web |url=https://www.courant.com/2018/10/23/supreme-court-orders-documents-seized-from-sandy-hook-shooter-lanzas-home-released-key-win-in-courants-yearslong-fight-for-records/ |title= Supreme Court Orders Documents Seized From Sandy Hook Shooter Lanza's Home Released; Key Win In Courant's Yearslong Fight For Records |last=Altimari |first=Dave |date=October 23, 2018 |website=Hartford Courant |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241003090343/https://www.courant.com/2018/10/23/supreme-court-orders-documents-seized-from-sandy-hook-shooter-lanzas-home-released-key-win-in-courants-yearslong-fight-for-records/ |archive-date=October 3, 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=July 16, 2026}}</ref> Lanza wrote that he was molested "at least a dozen times" by doctors during [[Male genital examination |genital exam]]s with his parents' knowledge.<ref name="courant-2018-docs">{{cite web |url=https://www.courant.com/2018/12/09/courant-exclusive-more-than-1000-pages-of-documents-reveal-sandy-hook-shooter-adam-lanzas-dark-descent-into-depravity/ |title=Courant exclusive: More than 1,000 pages of documents reveal Sandy Hook shooter Adam Lanza's dark descent into depravity |last1=Altimari |first1=Dave |last2=Kovner |first2=Josh |date=December 9, 2018 |website=Hartford Courant |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260712063311/https://www.courant.com/2018/12/09/courant-exclusive-more-than-1000-pages-of-documents-reveal-sandy-hook-shooter-adam-lanzas-dark-descent-into-depravity/ |archive-date=July 12, 2026 |url-status=live |access-date=July 16, 2026}}</ref><ref name="nypost-2018">{{Cite web |last=Jaeger |first=Max |title=Sandy Hook killer described 'scorn for humanity' and severe isolation |url=https://nypost.com/2018/12/09/sandy-hook-killer-described-scorn-for-humanity-and-severe-isolation/ |date=December 9, 2018 |website=[[New York Post]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250824175058/https://nypost.com/2018/12/09/sandy-hook-killer-described-scorn-for-humanity-and-severe-isolation/ |archive-date=August 24, 2025 |url-status=live |access-date=July 16, 2026 |language=en-US}}</ref>

"I don't see how I and every child was not raped by doctors: We did not consent to it. We only did it because our parents made us. Which is another point: If we as a society taught children that they are independent of their parents and that they should not blindly follow them, they would not be abused by their parents in the way they often are."}}<ref name="courant-2018-docs"/><ref name="nypost-2018"/>

In two personal messages with friends, Lanza argued that there is nothing wrong with pedophilia.<ref name="langman-2015"/> In the same messages, Lanza affirmed that he is not a pedophile and that he never had sexual activity with children nor desired it.<ref name="langman-2015"/> Lanza told his friend that pedophilia is "a disease that needed to be treated and not looked at as evil".<ref name="ConnecticutPost"/> In some emails, Lanza described pedophiles as a "threat" that could "influence a child".<ref name="beast-online-life"/> According to the Connecticut Office of the Child Advocate, there is no evidence nor records that Lanza had pedophiliac tendencies.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=101}} The FBI concluded in 2014 that there is no evidence that Lanza ever acted on his academic interest in pedophilia.<ref name="providence-journal-2017">{{cite web |url=https://www.providencejournal.com/story/news/2017/10/24/fbi-sandy-hook-shooter-planned-attack-for-months/18036165007/ |title=FBI releases documents on 2012 Sandy Hook school shooting |last1=Altimari |first1=Dave |last2=Kauffman |first2=Matthew |last3=Kovner |first3=Josh |date=October 24, 2017 |website=The Providence Journal |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260716102100/https://www.providencejournal.com/story/news/2017/10/24/fbi-sandy-hook-shooter-planned-attack-for-months/18036165007/ |archive-date=July 16, 2026 |url-status=live |access-date=July 16, 2026}}</ref><ref name="beast-online-life"/>

=== Online isolation and activities ===

Lanza's online activity was a primary focus for investigators, as it provided the only real window into his deteriorating mental state and his obsession with [[mass murder]]. In his final years, he lived in near-complete isolation within his room, dedicating his time to browsing the Internet and playing ''[[World of Warcraft]]'' and other video games.<ref name="wcnc-2017">{{Cite web |date=2017-10-24 |title=Newly released FBI documents reveal disturbing details about Sandy Hook shooter Adam Lanza |url=https://www.wcnc.com/article/news/national/newly-released-fbi-documents-reveal-disturbing-details-about-sandy-hook-shooter-adam-lanza/97-485814709 |access-date=2026-02-08 |website=wcnc.com |language=en-US}}</ref> The Office of the Child Advocate report states that he "descended" into a world where his only communication with the outside world was with members of a cyber-community, "a small community of individuals that shared his dark and obsessive interest in mass murder".{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=100}}

Lanza never permitted others to access his bedroom, not even his own mother. Lanza had also taped black plastic garbage bags over the windows in his bedroom in order to block out sunlight.<ref name="CNN-grave">{{cite news |last=Smith |first=Matt |url=http://www.cnn.com/2013/11/25/justice/sandy-hook-shooting-report/ |title=Sandy Hook killer Adam Lanza took motive to his grave |work=CNN |access-date=December 29, 2013 |date=November 26, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131218072027/http://www.cnn.com/2013/11/25/justice/sandy-hook-shooting-report/ |url-status=live |archive-date=December 18, 2013}}</ref> He had cut off contact with both his father and brother in the two years before the shooting. At one point, he communicated with his mother only by email, despite living in the same house together. When [[Hurricane Sandy]] struck the Northeastern U.S. in October 2012, the Lanza home was without electricity for days<ref name="salam-2017"/><ref name="wcnc-2017"/> and Lanza was scared.<ref name="providence-journal-2017"/> Nancy Lanza suggested going to a hotel, but Adam refused to leave the house, so they both stayed home.<ref name="salam-2017"/><ref name="wcnc-2017"/> A document titled "Selfish", describing Lanza's belief in the inherent selfishness of women, was found on his computer after his death.<ref name="The Reckoning" /><ref name="ABC-bedroom-2013">{{cite news |url=https://abcnews.go.com/US/sandy-hook-report-inside-gunman-adam-lanzas-bedroom/story?id=21009111 |title=Sandy Hook Report: Inside Gunman Adam Lanza's Bedroom |work=ABC News |date=November 25, 2013 |access-date=December 29, 2013 |archive-date=December 31, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131231003215/http://abcnews.go.com/US/sandy-hook-report-inside-gunman-adam-lanzas-bedroom/story?id=21009111 |url-status=live}}</ref> Lanza had two [[Tumblr]] accounts, "gayfortimk" and "queerforkimveer", named after school shooters [[Tim Kretschmer]] and [[Kimveer Gill]].<ref name="beast-online-life"/> Lanza glorified previous school shooters on his Tumblr accounts and deleted his posts in November 2012.<ref name="beast-online-life"/>

In early 2016, officials confirmed that a 25-second video of a man playing ''[[Dance Dance Revolution]]'' was Lanza. In Connecticut's final report on Lanza, it was stated that he was obsessed with the game and would play at a Connecticut theater for up to 10 hours a day every weekend.<ref>{{cite news |last1=NG |first1=ALFRED |date=February 23, 2016 |title=Officials confirm 2012 video is of Newtown shooter Adam Lanza playing 'Dance Dance Revolution' |url=https://www.nydailynews.com/2016/02/23/officials-confirm-2012-video-is-of-newtown-shooter-adam-lanza-playing-dance-dance-revolution/ |access-date=January 11, 2024 |publisher=NY DAILY NEWS |agency=NY DAILY NEWS}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-12-09 |title=More than 1,000 pages of documents reveal Sandy Hook shooter Adam Lanza's dark descent |url=https://www.latimes.com/nation/la-na-adam-lanza-sandy-hook-20181209-story.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250827202419/https://www.latimes.com/nation/la-na-adam-lanza-sandy-hook-20181209-story.html |archive-date=August 27, 2025 |access-date=2026-02-08 |website=Los Angeles Times |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Webster |first=Stephen C. |date=2013-11-26 |title=Newtown Probe: Lanza was Obsessed with Dancing Game |url=https://progressive.org/%3Fq%3Dnews/2013/11/185649/newtown-probe-lanza-was-obsessed-dancing-game/ |access-date=2026-02-09 |website=Progressive.org |language=en-us}}</ref> If a stranger tried to join him for a [[two-player game]], he would walk away from the arcade machine.<ref name=frustrating-wapo/> Lanza would occasionally play the game at the theater up to a month before the shootings.<ref name="The Reckoning"/>

Lanza had an unnamed friend with whom he would have wide-ranging conversations about various topics, including computers, chimpanzee behavior, mental health, human nature, morality, prejudice, Lanza's family, and mass murderers.<ref name="katersky-2014">{{cite web |url=https://abcnews.com/US/disturbing-things-learned-today-sandy-hook-shooter-adam/story?id=27087140 |title=5 Disturbing Things We Learned Today About Sandy Hook Shooter Adam Lanza |last1=Katersky |first1=Aaron |last2=Kim |first2=Susanna |date=November 21, 2014 |website=ABC News |publisher=ABC News Network |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260212112702/https://abcnews.com/US/disturbing-things-learned-today-sandy-hook-shooter-adam/story?id=27087140 |archive-date=February 12, 2026 |url-status=live |access-date=April 11, 2026}}</ref>{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=99}} The unnamed witness met Lanza sometime in 2011.<ref name="south-bend">{{cite web |url=https://www.southbendtribune.com/story/news/2013/12/29/despite-files-school-shooter-remains-enigma/116963204/ |title=Despite files, school shooter remains enigma |last=Reports |first=Staff |date=December 29, 2013 |website=South Bend Tribune |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250520022710/https://www.southbendtribune.com/story/news/2013/12/29/despite-files-school-shooter-remains-enigma/116963204/ |archive-date=May 20, 2025 |url-status=live |access-date=April 11, 2026}}</ref> They sometimes played ''Dance Dance Revolution'', watched horror movies, and went hiking together.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=99}} He reported in police interviews that Lanza "was capable of laughing, smiling, and making jokes, though always in a dry fashion".<ref name="south-bend"/> The friend stated that in general, Lanza would adopt "a very nihilist take on things" and seemed "overtly fatalistic and bleak".<ref name="south-bend"/> In June 2012, Lanza had a falling out with his friend and they stopped spending time together.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=99}}

=== Obsession with mass shootings ===
Investigation findings revealed Lanza had a keen interest in mass shootings, such as the [[Columbine High School massacre]]. He made a spreadsheet with detailed information on mass shooters and mass shooting incidents, along with making [[Tumblr]] accounts named after school shooters.<ref name="pilkington-2013">{{cite news |last1=Pilkington |first1=Ed |title=Sandy Hook report – shooter Adam Lanza was obsessed with mass murder |url= https://www.theguardian.com/world/2013/nov/25/sandy-hook-shooter-adam-lanza-report |work=[[The Guardian]] |date=November 25, 2013 |access-date=September 9, 2026 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="beast-online-life"/>

Lanza edited several Wikipedia entries on mass killings and mass murderers from 2009 to 2010.{{sfn|Kovner|Altimari|2018|loc=He was also known to have edited Wikipedia accounts of mass shootings.}}{{sfn|Solomon|2014|loc=He started editing Wikipedia entries on various well-known mass murderers and seems to have been eerily well informed.}}<ref name="langman-2015"/><ref name="courant-spreadsheet"/>
Most of his edits pertained to adding information on the weaponry used by mass murderers.<ref name="langman-2024"/>
He used "Kaynbred" as his username on Wikipedia.<ref name="courant-spreadsheet"/>
<!-- Adam Lanza's Wikipedia accounts were: -->
<!-- * [[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Contributions/kaynbred][kaynbred]] -->
<!-- * [[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Contributions/blarvink][blarvink]] -->
<!-- * [[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Contributions/KnaveSmig][KnaveSmig]] -->

In his room, investigators uncovered clippings, including a story from ''[[The New York Times]]'' detailing an incident in 1891 where a man shot at school children. His computer contained two videos of gunshot suicides, movies that showed [[school shooting]]s, and two pictures of Lanza pointing guns at his own head.<ref name="CNN-grave" /><ref name="ConnecticutPost" /> Records show that Nancy planned on gifting Adam a CZ 83 pistol for Christmas in 2012.<ref name="goodwin-2013">{{cite web |url=https://www.yahoo.com/news/sandy-hook-report--shooter-s-mom-wanted-to-buy-him-gun-for-christmas-210859068.html |title=Sandy Hook report: Shooter's mom wanted to buy him gun for Christmas |last=Goodwin |first=Liz |date=November 25, 2013 |website=Yahoo News |publisher=Yahoo |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250214171845/https://www.yahoo.com/news/sandy-hook-report--shooter-s-mom-wanted-to-buy-him-gun-for-christmas-210859068.html |archive-date=February 14, 2025 |url-status=live |access-date=April 28, 2026}}</ref>

Lanza was a member of what is now commonly referred to as the [[True Crime Community]].<ref name="beast-online-life">{{Cite web |last=Weill |first=Kelly |title=Adam Lanza's Terrifying Online Life Revealed |url=https://www.thedailybeast.com/adam-lanzas-terrifying-online-life-revealed-mass-shooting-spreadsheets-columbine-collages-and-murder-tumblrs/ |date=2017-10-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251018174746/https://www.thedailybeast.com/adam-lanzas-terrifying-online-life-revealed-mass-shooting-spreadsheets-columbine-collages-and-murder-tumblrs/ |archive-date=October 18, 2025 |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=The Daily Beast |language=en}}</ref><ref name="beast-TCC-2019">{{cite web |last=Weill |first=Kelly |url=https://www.thedailybeast.com/inside-the-tumblr-community-where-women-worship-killers/ |title=Inside the Tumblr Community Where Women Worship Killers |date=January 11, 2019 |website=Daily Beast |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210724192132/https://www.thedailybeast.com/inside-the-tumblr-community-where-women-worship-killers |archive-date=July 24, 2021 |access-date=July 16, 2026}}</ref> Lanza had an account on a forum titled "Super Columbine Massacre RPG", which discusses the [[Super Columbine Massacre RPG!|video game of the same name]] and other mass shootings. Lanza used the username "Smiggles". Investigators saw Lanza's posts on Tumblr and the Super Columbine Massacre RPG! forum as a clear indicator about Lanza's fascination with Columbine and other mass shooting incidents. In one post on the forum, Lanza describes having a dream about Columbine while he was asleep.<ref name="beast-online-life"/> In another, he wrote: "I'm still waiting for a mass shooter who eschews 9mm pistols and instead buys an AK-47 pistol, 30 30-round magazines, and 1000 hollow points".<ref name="beast-online-life"/> In late 2011, Lanza sympathized with Dylan Klebold and described Eric Harris as "a monster".<ref name="beast-online-life"/>

Lanza had posted writings related to the [[2011 Norway attacks]] perpetrated by [[Anders Behring Breivik]], citing his mass murder as "impressive", and writing that he "finally outdid [[Woo Bum-kon]]", referring to how South Korean policeman Woo's spree killing had been the deadliest mass shooting to date when Breivik's attacks occurred. He also contrasted Breivik to American-Israeli mass murderer [[Baruch Goldstein]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Siemaszko |first=Corky |date=January 16, 2014 |title=Norway mass murderer had a fan in Sandy Hook killer Adam Lanza |url=https://www.nydailynews.com/2014/01/16/norway-mass-murderer-had-a-fan-in-sandy-hook-killer-adam-lanza/ |access-date=May 7, 2024 |website=New York Daily News |language=en-US}}</ref>
On the Columbine forum, Lanza wrote "[[Serial killer]]s are lame. Everyone knows that mass murderers are the cool kids".<ref name="beast-online-life"/>

[[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] (FBI) documents released in 2017 revealed that a man warned the Newtown Police Department in 2008—four years before the massacre—that Lanza was planning to kill his mother and children at Sandy Hook Elementary School.<ref name="salam-2017">{{cite web |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2017/10/26/us/adam-lanza-sandy-hook.html |title=Adam Lanza Threatened Sandy Hook Killings Years Earlier, Records Show |last=Salam |first=Maya |date=October 26, 2017 |website=New York Times |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230524235919/https://www.nytimes.com/2017/10/26/us/adam-lanza-sandy-hook.html |archive-date=May 24, 2023 |access-date=April 11, 2026}}</ref>
Authorities discovered a massive, 7-by-4-foot (2.1-by-1.2 m) spreadsheet on his computer that documented hundreds of mass murders dating back to the 1700s.<ref name="courant-spreadsheet">{{Cite web |last=Altimari |first=Dave |title=Sandy Hook shooter Adam Lanza's spreadsheet detailing centuries of mass violence served as a road map to murder |url=https://www.courant.com/2018/12/09/sandy-hook-shooter-adam-lanzas-spreadsheet-detailing-centuries-of-mass-violence-served-as-a-road-map-to-murder/ |date=December 9, 2018 |website=Hartford Courant |language=en-US |archive-date=August 31, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230831083541/https://www.courant.com/2018/12/09/sandy-hook-shooter-adam-lanzas-spreadsheet-detailing-centuries-of-mass-violence-served-as-a-road-map-to-murder/ |url-status=live |access-date=2026-02-08}}</ref> It contained 17 categories, including weapon types, casualty counts, and the death of the perpetrator. Some investigators believe he was studying these cases to maximize his own lethality or to compete for a high ranking on his own list. He reportedly told an online contact in July 2012 that he only had a perfunctory interest in mass murderers and no longer cared about anything.{{sfn|Office of the Child Advocate|2014|p=100}} Lanza did not have a criminal record before the shooting.<ref name="llanos-2012"/><ref name="NPRYost12-15-12"/><ref name="EveningSun">{{cite news |first1=Susan |last1=Misur |first2=Angi |last2=Carter |first3=Jenn |last3=Smith |url=http://www.eveningsun.com/ci_22195195/adam-lanzas-family-seemed-like-normal-family |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121218054044/http://www.eveningsun.com/ci_22195195/adam-lanzas-family-seemed-like-normal-family |archive-date=December 18, 2012 |date=December 14, 2012 |title=Adam Lanza's family seemed like normal family, neighbors say |newspaper=The Evening Sun |access-date=December 15, 2012}}</ref>

Data recovered from a portable GPS shows that Lanza was in the vicinity of the Sandy Hook Elementary School a day prior to the shooting. Reports say that he owned a portable GPS device.<ref name="gps-2013">{{cite web |title=State Police Summary: Lanza Received No Help; No Indication Of Motive |url=http://articles.courant.com/2013-11-25/news/hc-sandy-hook-report-released-20131122_1_lanza-received-adam-lanza-sandy-hook-elementary-school |url-status=dead |last=Altimari |first=Dave |date=November 25, 2013 |newspaper=[[The Hartford Courant]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131216160229/http://articles.courant.com/2013-11-25/news/hc-sandy-hook-report-released-20131122_1_lanza-received-adam-lanza-sandy-hook-elementary-school |archive-date=December 16, 2013 |access-date=May 10, 2026}}</ref>
