'''Christian Giordano''' (born 24 July 1985) is an Italian lawyer and politician of the [[Five Star Movement]]. He has served as president of the [[Province of Potenza]] since 2022.

== Life and career ==
Giordano was born in [[Polla, Campania]], in 1985, and grew up in the [[province of Potenza]]. He graduated in law from the [[University of Naples Federico II]] in 2012.<ref name=cv>{{cite web |title=Curriculum vitae avv. Christian Giordano |date=January 2025 |url=https://mycity.s3.sbg.io.cloud.ovh.net/4362366/Curriculum-vitae-avv.CHRISTIAN-GIORDANO-(gennaio-2025).pdf |access-date=23 August 2026}}</ref> In the same year, he became a professional journalist registered with the Order of Journalists of [[Basilicata]]. After working in management, he began practising as a lawyer at the Bar of Potenza in 2020.<ref name=cv/>

In June 2017, Giordano was elected mayor of [[Vietri di Potenza]] as the candidate of a [[Civic list (Italy)|civic list]], receiving 53.4% of the vote.<ref>{{cite news |title=C. Giordano eletto sindaco del comune di Vietri di Potenza |work=[[Il Sole 24 Ore]] |date=11 June 2017 |url=https://st.ilsole24ore.com/speciali/2017/elezioni-amm/risultati/amministrative_comunali/dati/sindaco_comune_vietri_di_potenza.shtml |access-date=23 August 2026}}</ref> He was re-elected mayor in 2022.<ref>{{cite web |title=Risultati elezioni comunali 2022 – Vietri di Potenza |work=[[Corriere della Sera]] |url=https://www.corriere.it/elezioni/risultati-comunali-2022/vietri-di-potenza_076096.shtml |access-date=23 August 2026}}</ref>

In September 2022, Giordano was elected [[List of presidents of the Province of Potenza|president of the Province of Potenza]], supported by the [[Five Star Movement]] and the [[Democratic Party (Italy)|Democratic Party]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Provincia di Potenza: eletto presidente candidato M5S-Pd |url=https://www.ansa.it/basilicata/notizie/2022/09/11/provincia-di-potenza-eletto-presidente-candidato-m5s-pd_f5b6de30-17e7-46c6-a660-47699ce960cd.html |work=[[Agenzia Nazionale Stampa Associata|ANSA]] |date=11 September 2022 |access-date=23 August 2026}}</ref> He received 24,587 weighted votes, ahead of Francesco Genzano, the [[Lega (political party)|Lega]]-backed candidate, who received 22,640.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.lagazzettadelmezzogiorno.it/news/potenza/1357468/provincia-di-potenza-giordano-e-il-nuovo-presidente.html |title=Provincia di Potenza, Giordano è il nuovo presidente |work=[[La Gazzetta del Mezzogiorno]] |first=Antonella |last=Inciso |date=11 September 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Potenza, Giordano presidente della Provincia: "Priorità a scuola e strade" |url=https://www.quotidianodelsud.it/basilicata/potenza/politica/elezioni/2022/09/12/potenza-giordano-presidente-della-provincia-priorita-a-scuola-e-strade |work=[[Il Quotidiano del Sud]] |date=12 September 2022 |access-date=23 August 2026}}</ref> On 5 July 2024, he became president of [[Union of Italian Provinces|UPI Basilicata]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Christian Giordano è il nuovo presidente dell'Upi Basilicata |work=UPI Basilicata |date=7 July 2024 |url=https://www.upibasilicata.it/christian-giordano-e-il-nuovo-presidente-dellupi-basilicata/ |access-date=23 August 2026}}</ref>

In April 2026, Giordano was appointed regional coordinator of the [[Five Star Movement]] in Basilicata by party leader [[Giuseppe Conte]], succeeding Arnaldo Lomuti.<ref>{{cite news |title=Christian Giordano nuovo coordinatore del Movimento 5Stelle |work=[[RAI|RaiNews]] |date=28 April 2026 |url=https://www.rainews.it/tgr/basilicata/articoli/2026/04/christian-giordano-nuovo-coordinatore-del-movimento-5stelle-3cc0f4a7-de9c-4124-be04-ed861471178d.html |access-date=23 August 2026}}</ref>

In August 2026, Giordano came under criticism over delays in signing an agreement and submitting a timetable for road infrastructure funding allocated to the Province of Potenza, while announcing plans to finance the works through a loan.<ref name=cronache>{{cite news |title=Le azioni di Pepe e le chiacchiere di Giordano |work=Le Cronache Lucane |first=Massimo |last=Dellapenna |date=22 August 2026 |url=https://www.lecronachelucane.it/2026/08/22/le-azioni-di-pepe-e-le-chiacchiere-di-giordano/ |access-date=23 August 2026}}</ref> His political style has been criticized as overly tactical and media-focused, with greater emphasis on political positioning and communication.<ref name=cronache/>
